jd.text:
Job Title – Data Engineer - Industrial and Refinery Data
Company – TCS (MEA)
Location – Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (KSA)
Job type – Full time

About Us:
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world’s largest businesses in their transformation journeys for over 50 years. TCS offers a consulting-led, cognitive powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology and engineering services and solutions. This is delivered through its unique Location Independent Agile™ delivery model, recognized as a benchmark of excellence in software development.
A part of the Tata group, India's largest multinational business group, TCS has over 616,171 of the world’s best-trained consultants with 157 nationalities in 53 countries. For more information, visit www.tcs.com and follow TCS news at @TCS_News.

Job Description:

Desired Competencies (Technical / Behavioral):

Must-Have:

· Experience building reliable data pipelines for high-volume structured and time-series data. 
· Hands-on knowledge of SQL, Python, APIs, data modelling and ETL/ELT frameworks.
· Experience integrating historians, laboratory, maintenance, asset and engineering data sources.
· Strong understanding of data quality, metadata, lineage, security and access controls. 
· Familiarity with feature stores, vector databases or AI-ready data platforms.

Good-to-Have:

· Oil & Gas, refinery or process manufacturing data experience. 
· Exposure to OSI PI or equivalent historians, LIMS, CMMS/SAP and streaming platforms. 
· Ability to contextualize tag-level data against equipment, process hierarchy and engineering information.

Application Deadline: 10-October-2026

Why Join Us?
Work at the forefront of AI-driven applications and autonomous agents.

jd.text:
Master Works is looking for an Agentic AI, Engineer to join our growing team and design, build, and deploy agentic AI systems that can plan, reason, and act. The role covers both single-agent and multi-agent systems, as well as orchestration of workflows involving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context engineering, reasoning, tool calling, memory, and inter-agent communication. This role is ideal for a strong software engineer with hands-on AI/ML development experience and a passion for transforming generative AI models into reliable, goal-driven systems capable of solving complex, real-world business problems.
Key Responsibilities:
Architect, build, and deploy agentic AI systems that integrate AI agents with foundation models, enterprise systems, third-party tools, and APIs using established agentic frameworks or custom-built orchestrators.
Build and maintain retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory, and reasoning pipelines that ground agent decisions in reliable, real-world data and enable persistent, contextual, and adaptive behavior.
Design single-agent and multi-agent workflows, including planning, delegation, tool selection, handoffs, inter-agent communication, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Optimize orchestration and reasoning performance while balancing autonomy, latency, cost, interpretability, reliability, and maintainability.
Collaborate with Generative AI engineers, application engineers, MLOps engineers, and product teams to move agentic AI solutions from prototype to production.
Monitor, evaluate, and benchmark agent performance, and help ensure AI systems are safe, accurate, trustworthy, observable, and capable of delivering a high-quality user experience.
Document agent architectures, communication flows, guardrails, context-engineering strategies, memory design, tool interfaces, and orchestration logic to ensure clarity and reproducibility.
Stay current with advances in agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, model-context protocols, cognitive architectures, evaluation methods, and AI safety mechanisms.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and deliver complete AI solutions for customers.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
2+ years of hands-on experience developing agentic AI systems, LLM-powered applications, or advanced Generative AI solutions.
Preferably 5+ years of overall professional software engineering experience
Contributions to open-source agentic AI frameworks, orchestration platforms, evaluation tooling, or agent communication protocols.
Experience building microservices and deploying AI applications on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience with AI safety, guardrails, observability, traceability, evaluation, and explainability for agentic AI systems.
Experience deploying LLM or agentic workloads in production using containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and modern MLOps or LLMOps practices.
Job Location: HQ

jd.text:
We are looking for a Senior Software Developer with strong AI/ML development experience to design, develop, and integrate intelligent applications and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong software engineering background combined with hands-on experience building applications using Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, Machine Learning, and AI APIs.
The candidate will work closely with software engineers, architects, DevOps/SRE teams, data engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and production-ready AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop scalable, reliable, and maintainable software applications incorporating AI capabilities.
Develop and integrate solutions using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Build AI-powered applications using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search.
Develop and integrate AI agents and agentic workflows for business automation and intelligent decision-making.
Integrate commercial and open-source AI models through APIs and SDKs.
Work with models such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, or equivalent technologies.
Design and implement prompt engineering, context management, evaluation, and AI guardrails.
Develop REST APIs, microservices, and backend components required to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications.
Implement AI solutions using Python and/or modern backend technologies such as Node.js, Java, or .NET.
Work with databases including SQL/NoSQL databases and vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, or equivalent.
Develop data ingestion and processing pipelines required for AI/RAG solutions.
Optimize AI applications for performance, scalability, cost, latency, and reliability.
Implement automated testing and evaluation frameworks for AI applications.
Collaborate with DevOps/MLOps teams to deploy and operate AI workloads in cloud environments.
Apply security, privacy, governance, and responsible-AI principles when developing AI solutions.
Conduct technical analysis, troubleshoot complex production issues, and provide recommendations for improvements.
Perform code reviews and contribute to engineering standards, architecture decisions, and best practices.
Mentor junior and mid-level developers and provide technical leadership within the development team.
Stay current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, models, and development practices.
Required Technical Skills

Software Engineering
7+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong experience with Python and at least one additional programming language such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, or Go.
Strong knowledge of REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures.
Strong understanding of software design principles, design patterns, clean code, and system architecture.
Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
AI / Generative AI
Hands-on experience developing and deploying AI/ML or Generative AI applications.
Strong understanding of LLMs and transformer-based models.
Practical experience with:
Prompt engineering
RAG architectures
Embeddings
Vector databases
Semantic search
LLM orchestration
AI agents
Function/tool calling
Structured outputs
AI evaluation
AI safety and guardrails
Experience integrating LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or equivalent.
Experience with AI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent.
Experience with ML/AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or equivalent is an advantage.

Cloud & DevOps
Experience developing and deploying applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation.
Experience with AI/ML deployment and MLOps/LLMOps practices is highly desirable.
Understanding of application observability, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
Experience building enterprise-grade AI applications.
Experience taking AI/ML solutions from POC to production.
Experience with AI model evaluation, fine-tuning, or model customization.
Experience with cloud-native AI services.
Knowledge of AI security, data privacy, model governance, and responsible AI.
Experience with high-volume, distributed, or real-time systems.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

Key Competencies
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Strong ownership and delivery mindset.
Passion for emerging AI technologies and continuous learning.
Ability to mentor developers and provide technical leadership.

What We Offer
Opportunity to work on enterprise-scale AI and Generative AI projects.
Exposure to modern LLM, cloud, and AI engineering technologies.
Opportunity to design and implement AI solutions from architecture through production.
Collaborative environment with experienced software, cloud, DevOps, SRE, and AI engineering teams.
Opportunities for technical leadership and career growth.

jd.text:
Role Description The Senior Odoo Technical Developer role is a part-time remote position focused on designing, developing, and maintaining advanced Odoo modules and customizations to support Jadeer’s operations. The person in this role will configure and extend Odoo functionalities, integrate Odoo with internal and external systems. Daily tasks include writing and reviewing clean, efficient code, troubleshooting technical issues, improving database performance, and ensuring a secure and scalable architecture. The Senior Odoo Technical Developer will collaborate with functional teams to gather requirements, translate business needs into technical solutions, and provide guidance on best practices in Odoo development. The role also involves documenting technical designs, supporting deployments, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications
Strong software development and programming skills, including experience with Odoo frameworks and related technologies.
Hands-on expertise in systems integration, including connecting Odoo with external applications, services, and APIs.
Proficiency working with databases, including designing schemas, writing queries, and optimizing performance.
Ability to implement and adjust front-end elements using Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and related web technologies.
Previous experience in a senior or lead Odoo developer role, preferably supporting real estate or investment workflows.
Solid understanding of software architecture, version control (e.g., Git), and secure coding practices.
Manage Odoo.sh environments, Git branches, deployments, releases, and upgrade/migration considerations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical designs.
Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional, remote teams.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with Linux-based environments, containerization, or cloud platforms is an advantage.
